description: Lists tax facts for one country whose kb review date falls in a window of up to 18 months, grouped by the release that moves them or by review month, with a count per month and each listed fact's current value. Optional query narrows to one topic.

country.description: Country: au (Australia), ca (Canada), nz (New Zealand), uk (United Kingdom), us (United States).

query.description: Optional topic words, e.g. 'superannuation' or 'fuel excise'.

to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 18 months after from.

name: get_upcoming_changes
title: List expected tax figure changes
